description:
This role offers an opportunity to work on innovative projects and drive the development of cutting-edge platforms. As a Software Engineer in Platform Services, you will be part of a dynamic team responsible for designing and developing scalable and robust software solutions. Your expertise will contribute to the creation of efficient and reliable platforms, ensuring optimal performance and user experience. This role provides an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a diverse range of teams and stakeholders, allowing you to make a significant impact on the company's technology landscape.

 

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand platform requirements and design efficient solutions.
 Develop high-quality software components, ensuring code quality and maintainability.
 Implement and integrate platform features, following best practices and industry standards.
 Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the stability and reliability of the platform.
 Work closely with the architecture team to align with overall platform architecture and design principles.
 Document and maintain technical specifications and provide support for platform-related queries.
 Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing innovative solutions.
 Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to enhance team collaboration.
 Assist in performance optimization and scalability efforts to meet growing demands.
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on platform engineering.
 Proficiency in programming languages such as Go is a must;  with a strong understanding of software design principles. Scripting experience in Python or Bash
 Experience in cloud native technologies and Kubernetes is a must.
 Experience with version control systems and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices.

 Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and containerization technologies is a must.
 Understanding of cloud networking, including L4/L7 load balancers.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented mindset.
 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Passion for technology and a desire to stay updated with the latest industry advancements.
 
 
 Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 


 
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.  



 
 Learn more about life at Nokia .


 
 



 
 



 
 Our recruitment process 

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.  Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
